name.description: Folder name of the component in gitops/components/.

values.description: Helm values for this cluster. They override the default values of the component (sources/values.yaml).

description: gitops/clusters/<cluster>/cluster.yaml: the target of the cluster, the catalog components it enables with their value overrides, and the tenants it hosts.

components.description: Catalog components (gitops/components/<name>/) enabled on the cluster. manifests:render renders each one to rendered/<name>/.

kubernetesVersion.description: Kubernetes version of the cluster, without the v prefix. helm template renders with it (--kube-version) and kubeconform validates against it.

name.description: Cluster name. Must be equal to the folder name, and to the Terraform root in clusters/<name>/.

target.description: Where the cluster runs. A catalog component lists the targets it supports (GKE has Dataplane V2, so it skips cilium).

tenants.description: Tenants (gitops/tenants/<name>.yaml) onboarded on the cluster. The render passes them to every component as gitops.tenants.

title: GitOps cluster
